name: Vivillon
notes: Painted design (Meadow pattern): four wing islands (13, 15 forewing halves; 14, 16 hindwing halves) of flat pink/magenta/white/teal blocks between thin black veins (about 2 texels) that converge at each wing root, a two-tone black margin band, a fine felt-like grain over everything (the wing powder) and a 5-texel noise in _par. Body: grey head (6) and thorax (5) painted with vertical fur strokes, white collar (8), dark legs (7, 9), tan antenna clubs (1, 11) on a dark stalk (12); island 20 is the floating pattern-square particles.

So: wings get rows of small shingle scales (3 x 2.2 texels) in a polar lattice around each wing root (where the painted veins meet), tips pointing outward, half-scale stagger, a tiny per-scale tone jitter; scales tuck under the painted veins, which stay crisp and slightly raised. Velvet-matte _par. Head and thorax: short soft fur along the painted strokes. Antennae, stalk, legs, particles: untouched.

Body shader 3116720224 and Wing shader 2670489024 have no normal sampler: in game only _dif and _par (512, BC1) load. The scale relief is baked as faint tip highlight / tuck shade in _dif; the full relief is in the cache-only Body_nor.
